item.title: PyJWT: Public keys in DER form are accepted as HMAC secrets, bypassing the CVE-2022-29217 guard
item.description: Score 60/100 MEDIUM — CVSS 7.4 — ### Summary `HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key` blocks asymmetric keys from being used as HMAC secrets by searching for text markers only. It looks for `-----BEGIN` and for an `ssh-` prefix. The same key in DER form is binary ASN.1 and has neither marker, so it passes the check and is used as an HMAC secret. Full analysis, Sigma/YARA rules, IOCs, Attack Chain by CYBERDUDEBIVASH SENTINEL APEX v4.0.
